all_words.explanation: A listener is one member of an audience, so the two words describe the same people from slightly different angles.
A tortoise is a slow reptile and has no connection to public speaking or to the people who listen to a speech.
Applause is the typical response of an audience to a speaker, so the two words belong to the same situation of public speaking.
A lantern is a source of light and is unrelated to audiences or rhetoric.
A spectator is a person who watches an event, which overlaps closely in meaning with the people who form an audience.
A hairdryer is a household appliance and has no link to persuasive speaking or listeners.

explanation: The words listener, applause and spectator are linked to the idea of an audience, while tortoise, lantern and hairdryer are unrelated to it.
